answer: Harbor Leasing doesn't allow third-party buyouts, so we can't buy out your lease directly from them. You can still buy the car out yourself first and then sell it to us, or return it at the end of the lease. If you buy it out yourself and then sell it, you would follow the usual selling steps: get an offer, book an appraisal, have the car inspected, and sign the paperwork to get paid.
